headline: Turn scattered supplier signals into an explainable continuity review
capabilities: Unify risk data and score suppliers in real time
Provide visibility into financial health, operational capacity, and logistics reliability
Recommend mitigation actions like safety stock and dual sourcing
outcomes: Reduced disruption exposure with early risk detection and mitigation
Protected revenue by preventing supply chain interruptions
Improved procurement agility with real-time insights
Strengthened supplier relationships with better risk communication and proactive planning
why_try: It makes supplier-risk AI concrete: leaders can ask where exposure is concentrated, understand why a relationship is elevated, and compare mitigation options with procurement authority preserved.

sample_prompts.label: Review concentrated supplier exposure
sample_prompts.prompt: Where is supplier exposure concentrated, and which relationships should leadership review first?

sample_prompts.label: Explain an elevated supplier
sample_prompts.prompt: Explain why TechnoCore is elevated and show me the evidence by risk dimension.

sample_prompts.label: Review continuity threats
sample_prompts.prompt: Which recorded disruptions could threaten continuity, and what exposure should we validate?

sample_prompts.label: Compare backup sourcing options
sample_prompts.prompt: Compare backup sourcing options for review, but do not contact, qualify, select, or order from any supplier.

business_flow: Procurement managers, supply chain directors, and continuity leaders
Approved financial, quality, logistics, and external-risk sources
